summary: Held the entire episode. Price ran favorable almost immediately (from breakeven to +150-160pts by t=9-10m) and never came close to breakeven again, oscillating roughly +65 to +160pts through t=20m with normal pullback/rebound cycles (giveback 0-73% off local legs but never approaching the entry). No sustained directional break against the position ever appeared -- every dip was followed by a rebound, and the higher-TF context (5m/15m/1h/4h) stayed favorable throughout. Nothing here looked wrong-direction; it read as a working long with ordinary chop. Next time I'd watch for a close that actually revisits/undercuts entry (px approaching 0 or negative) or a giveback that keeps compounding across consecutive legs without a rebound -- neither happened here.
